goal: Give ControlFlow a deterministic score-plan command that turns the existing plan, sidecar, and verdict contracts into reproducible aggregate metrics. The scorer supplements, rather than replaces, the verifier's adversarial rubric and native Codex execution decisions.

phases.objective: Define the public JSON output and prove the scorer is initially absent.
success_criteria: The initial test fails because scripts/score-plan.ps1 does not exist.

phases.objective: Implement the six metrics, aggregate score, diagnostic issues, and deterministic verdict.
success_criteria: The bugfix golden plan scores 100 and returns APPROVED.

phases.objective: Make scoring discoverable in the planner, verifier, README, and contract suite.
success_criteria: Documentation names score-plan and all six metrics.

phases.objective: Prove the score-plan contract is portable, scoped, and consistent with the approved goal.
success_criteria: All tests pass with VALID ControlFlow contract suite.
scripts/score-plan.ps1 emits one parseable JSON object with six named metrics, aggregate score, deterministic verdict, and diagnostic issues.
A valid golden plan scores 100 and APPROVED; an unknown dependency scores zero on dependency_sanity and is not approved.
The scorer never executes declared plan commands and adds no dependencies or plugin runtime.
Windows PowerShell/Pester and PowerShell 7 full suites pass.
